how_to_apply: Download the application form and official notification from the JIPMER website.
Fill out the application form in the prescribed format.

content_sections.text: There are a total of 5 vacancies available across different project posts under the Department of Preventive and Social Medicine.

content_sections.heading: JIPMER Project Research Scientist I Eligibility Criteria

rows.qualification_required: Master’s degree in public health (MPH) from a recognized University/Institution.
Postgraduate degree in Social Work or Sociology or any other relevant discipline from a recognized university.
PhD in life Sciences from a recognized University.

M.Sc. in Life Sciences / Public Health / Health Sciences / Management or a related research discipline from a recognized University, with a minimum of 6 years of research experience in project coordination/management, including at least 3 years of experience in TB research.
Three-year Graduate degree in Life Sciences from a recognized university with three years of work experience in the relevant field.

content_sections.text: Download the application form and official notification from the JIPMER website. Fill out the application form in the prescribed format. Prepare a single PDF containing the filled application form, CV, and all supporting documents. Name the PDF file strictly in the format: "Candidate name_Post-name_year_application" (e.g., "James_DEO_2023_application"). Mention the name of the post applied for in the email subject line. Send the complete application by email to [email protected] on or before 17 October 2026, 01:00 PM.
